verdict.rationale: Algolia's own docs list an official MCP server in the main documentation navigation. Its official agent-skills repo includes an `algolia-mcp` skill covering search, analytics, and recommendations through that server, so an agent can connect via a first-party MCP server. Missing for 10: setup/connection instructions and transport/auth details, a full tool inventory, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
